## Goal
Generate 20 NEW mobile H5 app (mobile-first, single-screen-per-tap, used on a phone) product/site topics for the scene below.

## Scene
① 信息流/Feed 浏览
(L2 key: ① 信息流/Feed浏览)

## Existing topics already in this scene (40) — your new topics MUST differ from EVERY one
1. Personalized news feed by interest profile
2. Breaking news live ticker stream
3. Curated daily briefing digest card
4. Topic-specific feed (tech, sports, science)
5. Short-form video news feed
6. Local community news feed
7. Stock market and financial news feed
8. Science and research discovery feed
9. Podcast clip and audio snippet feed
10. Fact-checked source-verified feed
11. Followed journalist and columnist feed
12. Weather-integrated morning briefing
13. Long-read weekend edition feed
14. Labeled sponsored and native content feed
15. Trending topic real-time social feed
16. Reader-shared article social feed
17. War zone safety anonymous source feed
18. Multi-perspective global comparison feed
19. Newsletter digest in-app reader
20. Academic preprint and paper feed
21. Startup and VC ecosystem news feed
22. Government and policy update feed
23. Sports live commentary event feed
24. Entertainment and celebrity news feed
25. Health and wellness news curated feed
26. AI-Curated Personalized Newsfeed
27. Breaking News Live Ticker Stream
28. Local Community Events News Feed
29. Financial Markets News Live Stream
30. Sports Scores and Highlights Feed
31. Science and Tech Discovery Feed
32. Entertainment and Pop Culture Feed
33. Startup VC Funding News Feed
34. Climate and Environment News Feed
35. Health and Medical Discovery Stream
36. Political News Multi-Perspective View
37. Fashion and Style Trend Feed
38. Gaming and Esports Live News Feed
39. Agriculture and Food Industry News
40. Education Policy and Reform Feed

## Hard requirements
1. Output a JSON array of EXACTLY 20 new topic strings, in English.
2. Each topic = a concrete, buildable product/site idea, 4-12 words. Not a generic feature name.
3. CRITICAL — in-scene differentiation: every new topic must be a genuinely different
   sub-niche or use-case from EVERY existing topic listed above. Do NOT produce
   paraphrases, synonyms, renamings, or minor variations. Example: if "freelance
   invoice tracker" already exists, do NOT emit "invoice management tool for
   freelancers". If an idea overlaps in concept with any existing topic, discard it
   and find a different angle (different audience, sub-domain, mechanic, or context).
4. The 20 new topics must also be clearly distinct from each other.
5. Stay strictly within the scene — every topic must clearly belong to: ① 信息流/Feed 浏览
6. Lean mobile-native: e.g. "pocket habit-streak tracker", not a desktop multi-pane tool.
7. Output pure JSON — a single array of strings. No markdown fences, no commentary.

Return ONLY the JSON array of 20 strings.
